sn48.11:1.5: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako saddho hoti saddahati tathāgatassa bodhiṃ
sn48.11:1.6: itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho vijjācaraṇasampanno sugato lokavidū anuttaro purisadammasārathi satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavāti.
sn48.11:2.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave cattāro sammappadhāne ārabbha viriyaṃ paṭilabhati.
sn48.11:3.2: yaṃ kho bhikkhave cattāro satipaṭṭhāne ārabbha satiṃ paṭilabhati.
sn48.11:4.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako vossaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhati samādhiṃ labhati cittassa ekaggataṃ.
sn48.11:5.2: idha bhikkhave ariyasāvako paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
